en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European town at the foot of a wooded hillside. In the foreground there is a fenced public or private garden laid out with curving flowerbeds and young trees along a path. Behind the garden stand several late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century houses and small apartment buildings with steep gabled or mansard roofs, stucco or brick facades, and simple ornamentation. A broad unpaved or lightly paved street with utility poles runs at the right edge. On the distant ridge are terraced slopes, scattered houses, and a small chapel‑like building on the hilltop.
